results.title: Wellwood
results.overview: Nick makes an extraterrestrial discovery that he decides will cure his wife of her terminal illness.

results.title: Ecos and Other Extraordinary Tales
results.original_title: Ecos y otros relatos asombrosos ( el montaje del director )
results.overview: A tormented ghost and people struggling to survive in an apocalyptic world are the protagonists in this anthology of horror and science fiction stories.

results.title: Freedom to Dreams
results.overview: Daybreak in summer. A young girl from San Sebastian makes her way to the Peine del Viento (Wind Comb). She remembers the old sculptor Eduardo Chillida, who had been coming here since he was a boy. Today his three sculptures anchored to the rocks, in permanent conversation with the sea and the wind, have become a distinguishing feature of his city and of the whole Basque coast. At dawn, the young Jone asks herself about the sculptor and promises herself that she will go and find him.

results.title: The Sun Rises on Us All
results.overview: He sacrificed himself for love, taking the blame for a crime she committed. Unable to repay him for the sacrifice he made, she leaves to start a new life. Many years later, the former lovers meet again, but their estranged yet intertwined daily lives gradually unveil their tragic past. While one of them seeks redemption, the other yearns for release. In a painful and final farewell, they awaken from their wandering for one last heart-wrenching embrace.

results.title: Night Carnage
results.overview: A blogger who is also a werewolf meets a dashing playboy with a dark secret of his own. Starring Logan Andrews and Christian Howard.

results.title: RATS!
results.overview: In a surreal small‑town version of 2007 Texas, a young graffiti artist lands in jail and is coerced into spying on his cousin—suspected by an unhinged cop of dealing nuclear weapons. What follows is a frenetic, gross‑humored ride through conspiracy, over-the-top characters, and chaotic counterculture.

results.title: Organic Chemistry
results.overview: A shy guy silently falls in love with his straight forward coworker girl.  They need to get the work done at the advertisement agency.  What happens next to these organisms?

results.title: Vini Jr.
results.overview: Vini Jr. has it all: talent, resilience and boldness. Follow his dancing, unpredictable feet on his inspiring journey to becoming a global soccer star.

results.title: Shadows of Crime
results.overview: In a dystopian future, a man tries to earn money for his pregnant wife by selling a highly dangerous vaccine known for its addictive properties.

results.title: After Alma
results.overview: In the Astoria housing projects of New York, a demanding single mother grapples with her daughter’s last day home, revealing her own fragility.

results.title: Just a Summer
results.overview: Eva, her son Luchi and her sister Teresa vacation in the usual town. It is Eva’s first trip after her separation, but the first night they end up in the emergency room because Luchi has an accident. Between the doctor’s reprimands and shared laughter, the sisters confess their fears.

results.title: Midsummer Lucia
results.overview: The generation gap threatens to spoil everything when two grown grandchildren visit their grandmother in her garden. They have a special family tradition, but the grandmother thinks it's difficult to recreate the magic from the past when her grandchildren are always pressuring her to smoke in secret because everything has to be so 'woke'.

results.title: Lowland Kids
results.overview: As climate change erases the Louisiana coast, the last two teenagers on Isle de Jean Charles fight to stay on an island that's been in their family home for generations. Feature film continuation of a short of the same name.

results.title: Chal Mera Putt 4
results.overview: Living in the United Kingdom, a group of immigrant friends from different countries struggle to make ends meet while supporting their families back home. Until one fateful day when they find a bag with £1 million, sparking a hilarious misadventure none of them are prepared for.

results.title: What Marielle Knows
results.overview: Julia and Tobias face hilarious and cringe-worthy moments when their young daughter Marielle unexpectedly gains mind-reading powers. As family secrets come to light, they struggle to maintain privacy and normalcy in their daily lives.

results.title: Bosnian Knight
results.overview: A documentary about the history of the Bosnian national, linguistic, historical and cultural identity, from the earliest written records of their existence until present day.

results.title: The Weight of Sand
results.overview: Rashid, a Syrian theater director and political refugee, is working with other refugees on a performance. During a retreat at a beach house with his secret lover Adrian, tensions rise. The strain of their relationship weighs not only on Rashid’s real life but also on their play.
